info.name: StellarAI Decoder Validation API
info.description:
POST /api/v1/decoder/validate for StellarAI 1.0.4.

Start the API by double-clicking START_DECODER_API.bat after BUILD_DECODER_API.bat and decoder-api.config are in place. The decoder profile listens on http://127.0.0.1:8091.

Set the collection variables before sending a request. filePath and dbcPath are absolute paths on the machine running the API. Use a normal Windows path in the variable value, for example C:\measurements\sample.mf4. A collection script escapes backslashes for JSON. The measurement file and any DBC must sit inside the allowed-roots directories configured for the launcher. Do not point allowed-roots at a whole drive.

Replace the placeholder variable values. Do not leave the angle-bracket placeholders in a request you expect to decode.

DBC is required for ASC and BLF. Native MF4 and native MDF DAT/LOG files may omit dbcPath. Copy nextCursor from a response into the cursor variable before sending the cursor request. A cursor request sends only cursor and pageSize.

request.description: Set filePath to an MF4 measurement and dbcPath to the matching DBC. Both files must be under allowed-roots. Native MF4 can omit dbcPath; this example sends it. pageSize maximum is 10000. A full page returns nextCursor.
Set filePath to a BLF measurement and dbcPath to the matching DBC. BLF requires a DBC. Both files must be under allowed-roots.
Set filePath to a native MDF DAT or LOG measurement. Do not send dbcPath. The file must be under allowed-roots. A timestamped text table may also omit dbcPath. ASC and BLF cannot use this request.
Copy nextCursor from the previous response into the collection variable cursor. Send only cursor and pageSize. Do not repeat filePath, dbcPath, projectName, or a signal filter.
